Runes › Resolve

Shield Bash

ResolveRow 1

Whenever you get a new shield, your next attack on a champion deals bonus damage.

What it does

Whenever you gain a new shield, your next basic attack against a champion deals 5 - 30 (+2.5% Bonus Health) (+15.0% New Shield Amount) bonus adaptive damage. You have up to 2s after the shield expires to use this effect.

When to take it

Pick it on champions who shield themselves often in fights. If you rarely get shields, it does nothing.
